title: airtel SPEC — 'Ek Dhaaga' (brand film)
requirement: Airtel jaisi connectivity brand ke liye 9:16 spec brand film. Ek hi laal rang ka dhaaga frame me travel karta hai aur 6 baar shape badalta hai: signal -> highway -> rangoli -> network -> smile -> logo swoosh. Music-driven, no dialogue. Premium, clean, goosebumps.
